discovery.title: Researchers explore the use of AI and smart sensors to improve food safety quickly, affordably
discovery.summary: The smartJAN project, developed by the eVIDA research group at the University of Deusto in collaboration with Kernet and Fundación Miranda, has completed the development of a functional prototype capable of detecting the presence of LTPs (lipid transfer proteins), a family of plant proteins that includes allergens capable of triggering severe allergic reactions. These allergens are particularly relevant in the Mediterranean region.
